messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager — P1: Billing metering anomaly detected. token_count drift observed for tenant-aggregation in us-west-2. Spike in token deltas starting ~2025-08-01T03:12Z. Some overage flags emitted to customers; investigating.

sanjay: ack, taking lead. looking at emitter + consumer health. seeing backlog on kafka partition 12 and increased retry rates. will attach logs shortly.

emma: @sanjay ack. i'm oncall next hour. any immediate mitigation we can do customer-facing?

sanjay: enabled emergency suppression of overage notifications: `billing.suppress_overage_notifications(true)` applied to prod (10m window). paused downstream aggregator to avoid compounding. running quick recon command: `./tools/recon --range 03:00-03:20 --scope=all`

marco: seeing shadow tally lag ~18m vs live. emitter retry storm in logs: ```WARN emitter.cpp: retry threshold exceeded for id=em-4421 count=72``` looks like duplicate messages inflating counts.

monitoring-bot: alert: metering-heartbeat-missing svc=billing-aggregator host=billing-agg-07 last_heartbeat=00:18:30

lia: snapshot taken of current tallies before any backfill: `snapshots/tally-1750012345.tar.gz` stored in s3://redwood-backups/assessment/

sanjay: mitigation plan: 1) keep suppression until recon completes, 2) kafka replay from offset 1543245 for affected partitions, 3) run backfill to correct tallies after replay, 4) manual review before re-enable notifications. ETA for reconciliation ~35m. starting replay now.

emma: quick customer impact note for support: ~120 tenants have delayed usage windows; ~12 tenants received transient overage flags (no charges applied yet). prepare support playbook + banner template.

marco: running replay: `kafka-replay --topic=metering --from=1543245 --to=1544000 --filter=tenant:critical,high` throughput ~2k msg/s.

sanjay: replay progress ~45%, expected finish ~22m. queuing reconcile job immediately after.

billing-eng: can you coordinate a dry-run of the backfill on staging first? we should validate idempotency.

lia: staging dry-run queued. will validate deltas and produce reconciliation report when done.

emma: handoff -> @lia will be primary for next 2 hours for reconciliation and backfill checks. @sanjay continues root cause. Handoff summary: suppression enabled, replay running, snapshot taken, backfill planned, affected tenants ~120, transient overage flags ~12. Do NOT re-enable notifications without manual signoff.

sanjay: posting final: replay finished, reconcile job started; initial delta looks like +0.8% on aggregated counts (expected). will post final reconciliation delta and proposed timeline to re-enable notifications. :thumbsup: 

incident-bot: Incident updated: status=mitigating, runbook=meters/replay-and-reconcile, incident_id=INC-2025-1750
